system.name: Builderverse Construction Stack
system.author: Eddie Harris aka Eddie Kitsner
system.description: Comprehensive app rebuild for masonry estimation tools — removal of legacy modules, full refactor of core masonry calculator, and stability fixes across Builderverse Construction Stack.

change_scope.objective: Streamline and modernize Builderverse’s masonry estimator for accuracy, speed, and simplicity.

modules_removed.name: FullHouseBuildCalculator
modules_removed.reason: Deprecated workflow; replaced by modular estimation logic.
modules_removed.impact: Removed from UI, dependency chain detached, data archived.

modules_removed.name: FoundationCalculator
modules_removed.impact: Removed and archived; data available in legacy.json backup.

modules_rebuilt.name: MasonryCoreCalculator
features: Dynamic material ratio system (sand, cement, water, additives)
Regional mix profile integration (UK, Ireland, Global variants)
Auto rounding and waste adjustment logic
Output comparison with archived calculations for validation

modules_rebuilt.name: MaterialEstimator
features: Auto-link to supply cost index (Builderverse Supplier API)

bug_fixes.description: Crash when entering uneven pier measurements
bug_fixes.resolution: Handled zero-division and input parsing errors

bug_fixes.description: Incorrect cement bag output for large-scale projects
Foundation depth field causing mismatch in cost summary
bug_fixes.resolution: Removed dependency due to FoundationCalculator removal

deployment.release_notes: This update removes outdated full-build and foundation calculators, rebuilds the core masonry system, improves accuracy, and enhances user experience.

ai_context.objective: rebuild, validate, and optimize MasonryCoreCalculator within Builderverse standards
ai_context.response_format: structured code or QA logs only
